objective: Adrian confronts the immediate financial crisis of his first week at university, exhausting all conventional options and arriving at the private research hospital's experimental-medicine program as his only viable path to survival.
intendedChange: Adrian transitions from a passive victim of poverty to an active agent seeking a solution, moving from the desperation of his daily routine to the sterile, high-stakes environment of the research hospital where he identifies the male-fertility trial as his only option.
prohibitedPatterns: Introducing a sudden external threat, attack, or supernatural event in the final scene.
Having Adrian sign any legal documents or agreements in this chapter.
Revealing the true nature of the nanites or the accident that will occur later.
Using 'not X, but Y' contrast reframing in dialogue or narration.

scenes.purpose: Establish Adrian's physical state of exhaustion and hunger while he attempts to secure emergency aid from the university, highlighting the bureaucratic rigidity of the institution.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian leaves the financial aid office with a formal denial of emergency funds and a clear understanding that standard university channels will not support his immediate survival needs.

scenes.purpose: Depict Adrian's search for alternative income sources, demonstrating his refusal to engage in degrading labor or illegal activities despite his desperation.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian rejects a high-paying but exploitative gig offer, solidifying his commitment to finding a legitimate, if difficult, solution that preserves his dignity.

scenes.purpose: Introduce the private research hospital's experimental-medicine program as a viable financial option, contrasting the sterile corporate environment with Adrian's physical discomfort.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian gathers preliminary information about the trial's compensation and requirements, identifying it as the only option that meets his financial threshold without violating his moral boundaries.
